about_the_game:
Dive into massive, open alien environments to rescue, recover, and battle in the name of Humanity and profit. Select a mission, customize your equipment, drop, strike, and evac to space (if you can). Enjoy the physics based 1st person tactical shooter in VR or flat screen as single player or in 4 player co-op.

Solo or Co-op Multiplayer

Play alone or with friends or in public matches to team up against The Bugs and accomplish missions on planets across the edge of explored space where Infestations run rampant. Teamwork and smart tactics are the keys to victory. Every job is different, so coordinate with your team to choose complementary equipment and tactics for each job.

War is Business

Choose the jobs that are right for you and your team. Tougher jobs pay more but carry greater risk of violent dismemberment on alien soil. For some jobs you might need to bring your most skilled comrades; others are cake walks that you might choose to handle alone and keep all of the profit for yourself.

Tactics Are Everything

Focus on the mission objective, not on killing bugs because on most missions you simply can't kill them all. If you find yourself thinking “I made a mistake”, abandon the mission by calling for an evac. You don’t get penalized for leaving early, but you do face a large charge to restore your skills if the bugs get you. As a mercenary, you should feel no shame in admitting a battle is not worth it to your bank account.

Massive, Varied, and Moody Open Worlds

Explore unscripted gameplay through outdoor worlds that don't play like claustrophobic rooms without ceilings. You're free to go wherever they want whenever they want. Well, except for lava and bottomless cannons. You can only go there once.

The Bugs

Not much is known about the Bugs other than they don’t like humans very much and they are telepathic. They also disrupt much of the technology humanity relies upon, requiring you to take them out "old school".

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 11
  • Processor: Quad core+
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU, GTX 1060 or similar, Shader Model 5.0
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR, requires controllers

  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR, requires controllers
